sentences: A kitchen maid pours milk, slowly and carefully, into an earthenware bowl.
Light from the window on the left falls across her yellow bodice, her deep blue apron and the bread on the table.
Vermeer scattered tiny dots of light over the crust and the basket so their surfaces seem to glitter.
The blue of the apron is natural ultramarine, an expensive pigment he chose over the cheaper azurite.
Research by the Rijksmuseum shows he first painted more objects on the wall and then painted them out, which leaves her standing like a sculpture against a bare, bright wall.
Even the nail and its little hole are kept: a picture made great by what he took away.
